reason: Issue #308 (RFC 0031, Unresolved question 5, answered): the staged draft schema's local-identifier pattern gains a not that refuses U+0000-U+001F, U+007F-U+009F and U+2028-U+202E, and the extension-name pattern, at each of its three positions, moves its reserved prefix from a lookahead into a not that also refuses that class and escapes its class hyphen, so the patterns compile and admit the same names in every engine RFC 0031 section 1.7 lists. Staged draft only; the released 0.3.0 schema is unchanged.
